feature: Cloud Sync for Settings and Memory
description:
# Cloud Sync for Settings and Memory

Implement optional cloud synchronization for user settings, preferences, and Memory Layer data. Allow users to access their configuration from any machine while keeping data secure.

## Rationale
Enables seamless multi-device workflows. Addresses user pain point of context loss when switching machines. Complements Memory Layer by making it truly persistent across devices.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want my settings to sync between work and home machines so that I don't have to reconfigure
- As a privacy-conscious user, I want encryption so that my data stays private

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Settings sync across devices with user account
- [ ] Memory Layer can optionally sync to cloud
- [ ] End-to-end encryption for all synced data
- [ ] Offline mode works with local cache
- [ ] Users can export all data at any time
